sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. R.Sahoo, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. A.K. Mishra, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State-opposite parties.
3.

The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties to pay the compensation on account of acquisition of her land or in the alternative to allot a piece of land for construction of her dwelling house over the same.

4. Opposite party no.5 has filed counter affidavit, paragraph-5 whereof states as follows:
"5. That, it is humbly submitted that on receipt of requisition of private land for an area of Ac.21.99 dec from the requisitioning officer i.e. Executive Engineer, Balangir Irrigation division, Balangir proposal was submitted to Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Odisha, Bhubaneswar for issue 4(1) Notification of L.A. Act, 1894 vide office letter No.404, dt. 28.05.2002.
The Revenue & Disaster Management Department issued Notification U/S-4(1) of L.A. Act, 1894 vide Notification No.61216, dt. 27.12.2003.
The petitioner has claimed L.A. compensation on the basis of RoR issued to her by the Tahasildar, Titilagarh vide lease case No.16/4/2001-2002 in the village Satighat.
Khata No.116/324 recorded in the name of the petitioner does not find place in the land scheduled of Village Satighat notified U/S-4(1) of L.A. Act, 1894.
Copy of 4(1) notification and land schedule is Anupama Tripathy vs State Of Odisha & Ors.

5.
The petitioner files an affidavit in Court today after serving a copy thereof on the learned State Counsel.

Paragraph-3 of the said affidavit states as follows:
"3.

That the petitioner begs to submit that pursuant to the filing of the Counter Affidavit by the Opp. Party No.5, an enquiry was conducted by the Tahasildar,
Titlagarh on the direction of the Sub-Collector, Titlagarh and from the enquiry report, the Tahasildar, Titlagarh has given a report that the land of the petitioner to the extent of an area of Ac. 0.10 dec. has been used by the Water Resources Department for Irrigation Canal purpose and the petitioner has not been awarded with compensation.

Copy of the letter of the Tahasildar dt. 24.8.2021 alongwith the R.I. report is annexed hereunto and is marked as Annexure-7".
6.
Mr. A.K. Mishra, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State-opposite parties seeks time to obtain instructions in the matter and will file the same by way of an affidavit.

7. Put up this matter after two weeks.
